title: The Real Cost of Context: Predicting Compute Time and Energy Consumption in LLM Prefill and Decode Phases
title_zh: 上下文的真实成本：预测 LLM 预填充与解码阶段的计算时间与能耗

paragraphs.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into agentic architectures has substantially increased token consumption, raising concerns about their energy footprint. Yet, estimating the energy consumption of proprietary API-based models remains challenging, and existing approaches focus primarily on generated output tokens while overlooking the impact of the large input contexts characteristic of agentic workflows. To address this gap, we systematically profile compute time and energy consumption across a wide range of prefill (input) and decode (output) token lengths. Using generalized linear models, we show that decode compute time and energy scale linearly with output length, whereas prefill compute time and energy exhibit both linear and quadratic scaling with input length. These findings demonstrate that input context becomes a relevant factor for large-context workloads. Furthermore, we show that compute time serves as a reliable proxy for energy consumption when direct energy measurements are unavailable. Our mapping framework enables precise energy estimation and supports more sustainable deployment decisions for agentic AI.
paragraphs.zh: 将大语言模型（LLMs）集成到智能体架构中大幅增加了token消耗，引发了对其能源足迹的担忧。 然而，估算基于专有API的模型的能源消耗仍然具有挑战性，且现有方法主要关注生成的输出token，而忽视了智能体工作流所特有的大型输入上下文的影响。 为填补这一空白，我们系统性地测量了广泛的预填充（输入）和解码（输出）token长度范围内的计算时间与能源消耗。 利用广义线性模型，我们表明解码计算时间和能源消耗随输出长度呈线性扩展，而预填充计算时间和能源消耗随输入长度同时呈现线性和二次扩展。 这些发现表明，对于大型上下文工作负载而言，输入上下文成为一个相关因素。 此外，我们表明在无法直接测量能源消耗时，计算时间可作为能源消耗的可靠代理指标。 我们的映射框架能够实现精确的能源估算，并支持为智能体AI做出更可持续的部署决策。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have evolved from primarily supporting isolated conversational interactions to becoming foundational components of increasingly complex applications. As their adoption and usage continue to grow, accurately estimating their energy consumption is becoming an important operational and environmental concern Luccioni et al. (2023) ; Samsi et al. (2023) . For open-weight models deployed on accessible hardware, energy consumption can be measured through software telemetry or external power meters Argerich and Patiño-Martínez (2024) ; Husom et al. (2025) . (2026b) .

paragraphs.en: At the same time, modern LLM applications increasingly process large amounts of contextual information. This trend is particularly visible in multi-turn and agentic workflows, where conversation histories, system instructions, retrieved documents, tool outputs, and intermediate reasoning steps may be repeatedly included in the model input. Systems such as OpenClaw 1 1 1 https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw illustrate how complex agentic workflows can substantially increase input token consumption when solving long-running, multi-step tasks Bai et al. (2026) . Likewise, this challenge applies to any LLM application that processes long input contexts. Despite this development, existing energy estimation approaches largely focus on output tokens only and use short and fixed input lengths Argerich and Patiño-Martínez (2024) ; Rincé and Banse (2025) ; AI Energy Score (2025) . Consequently, the significant impact of input length on compute time as well as energy consumption remains inadequately modeled, particularly for large-context workloads.

paragraphs.en: We address this gap by systematically profiling LLM compute time and energy consumption across a grid of input and output token lengths, independently varying the tokens processed during prefill (input) and those produced during the decode (output) stage. Based on these empirical observations, we first fitted a Generalized Linear Model (GLM) on data collected via an API, capturing the contributions of input and output tokens towards compute time. We show that the number of input tokens has both linear as well as quadratic effects on compute time. These results demonstrate that estimates based predominantly on generated tokens Rincé and Banse (2025) ; Argerich and Patiño-Martínez (2024) may fail to capture an important component of inference cost for long-context requests.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过系统地剖析大语言模型在不同输入与输出token长度网格下的计算时间与能耗来填补这一空白，其中独立变化预填充（输入）阶段处理的token数量和解码（输出）阶段生成的token数量。 基于这些实证观察，我们首先利用通过API收集的数据拟合了一个广义线性模型（GLM），以刻画输入token和输出token对计算时间的贡献。 我们表明，输入token的数量对计算时间既有线性影响也有二次影响。 这些结果表明，主要基于生成token的估计方法 Rincé and Banse (2025)；Argerich and Patiño-Martínez (2024) 可能无法捕捉长上下文请求中推理成本的重要组成部分。

paragraphs.en: Our model accurately predicts compute times for input–output configurations with litte training data. Beyond prediction, the fitted GLM provides a compact and explainable representation of the LLM’s compute time behavior, which we use to support energy estimation. Because energy consumption depends on both execution time and power draw, compute time predictions alone are insufficient, particularly for proprietary APIs whose underlying hardware and power characteristics are not observable. Following the local-equivalence approach proposed by Krupp et al. Krupp et al. (2026b) , we collected compute time and energy consumption data from different local hardware and software configurations. This data was used to fit a GLM pair per hardware configuration, one predicting compute time as before and the other predicting energy consumption for input–output configurations. Through comparing the compute time GLMs and selecting the one behaving most similar to the API GLM, we were able to find an energy cost GLM whose direct energy measurements provide an empirically grounded basis for predicting the energy consumption of API-based inference.

paragraphs.en: Our work presents an empirically validated and explainable modeling approach for estimating LLM compute times and, through locally measured power characteristics, their associated energy consumption. Our method is suitable for both local and API-accessed LLMs and requires no access to the proprietary serving infrastructure. It is particularly relevant to context-intensive applications, including increasingly common multi-turn and agentic workflows.

paragraphs.en: We outline our primary contributions as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们概述一下我们的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We systematically characterize and quantify the influence of input token length on LLM compute time, with particular focus on the large-context requests increasingly prevalent in modern LLM applications.
paragraphs.zh: 我们系统地刻画并量化了输入 token 长度对 LLM 计算时间的影响，尤其关注在现代 LLM 应用中日益普遍的大上下文请求。

paragraphs.en: We develop generalized linear models (GLMs) that accurately predict LLM compute time and energy consumption from limited measurements while providing excellent interpretability through their direct correspondence to the algorithmic characteristics of LLM inference.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了广义线性模型（GLMs），能够从有限的测量数据中准确预测大语言模型（LLM）的计算时间与能耗，同时由于其与大语言模型推理的算法特性直接对应，提供了出色的可解释性。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that compute time can serve as a reliable proxy for energy consumption, enabling accurate estimation of the energy footprint of proprietary, API-accessed LLMs through locally profiled equivalent models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明计算时间可以作为能耗的可靠代理指标，从而能够通过对本地剖析的等效模型进行测量，准确估计专有的、通过API访问的大语言模型的能耗足迹。

paragraphs.en: The environmental impact of large-scale machine learning systems has received increasing attention in recent years. Early work primarily framed this issue around the cost of training large neural models, showing that gains in model accuracy often come with substantial financial and environmental costs, and proposing that model comparison should account for both predictive performance and computational resources Strubell et al. (2019) . Further work showed the dependence of carbon estimation on model architecture, accelerator type, datacenter efficiency, and geographic energy mix, making estimation difficult when these factors are not reported Patterson et al. (2021) .
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，大规模机器学习系统的环境影响受到了越来越多的关注。 早期工作主要围绕训练大型神经模型的成本来讨论这一问题，指出模型精度的提升往往伴随着巨大的财务和环境成本，并提出模型比较应同时考虑预测性能和计算资源 Strubell et al. (2019)。 后续研究表明，碳排放估算依赖于模型架构、加速器类型、数据中心效率和地理能源结构，当这些因素未被报告时，估算会变得困难 Patterson et al. (2021)。

paragraphs.en: While these studies focus primarily on measuring and attributing inference energy, complementary work has examined the serving mechanisms that determine how computional resources are used during inference. LLM inference was shown to have distinct power phases, with a compute-intensive prefill phase and a longer decode phase with different utilization characteristics Patel et al. paragraphs.en: EcoLogits Rincé and Banse (2025) , the closest approach to ours, models GPU energy using the number of output tokens, active model parameters, and an assumed batch size, while host-system energy is estimated from the request duration, inferred hardware requirements, and datacenter overhead. However, input token length is not explicitly represented in its energy or compute time models, so the additional prefill cost associated with longer prompts is not separately captured. Existing inference-energy evaluations have also focused predominantly on relatively short inputs. With work using prompts with lengths of 8 Argerich and Patiño-Martínez (2024) , 28–134 Luccioni et al. (2023) , and approximately 369 AI Energy Score (2025) tokens per request. This range is extended to 32,768 input tokens while controlling output length, but only in the context of locally deployed models running on known hardware Fernandez et al. (2025) . Consequently, the timing behavior of proprietary API-based LLMs over substantially longer contexts, and its implications for energy estimation, remains insufficiently characterized. We address this gap by systematically varying input length up to approximately 200,000 tokens while controlling output length and measuring its effect on request duration, compute time, and energy consumption under explicit hardware and power assumptions.

paragraphs.en: The energy consumption of API-served LLMs cannot be observed directly because their serving hardware and configuration remain hidden, even when the underlying model weights are publicly available. Compute time, however, is externally observable and provides a behavioral signature of the deployed system. Existing estimation approaches often emphasize output generation, treating input token processing as negligible Rincé and Banse (2025) ; Jegham et al. (2025) ; Kim et al. (2026) ; Argerich and Patiño-Martínez (2024) . This assumption becomes questionable for modern long-context and agentic workloads. Consequently, we propose a framework that separately characterizes the effects of input and output length on API inference time, including previously underexplored long-input configurations. We evaluate our approach on Mistral-Small-2603, a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Model with 119B total parameters, of which 6B are active. Its size allows it to fit on 2 H200 GPUs, making it a prime candidate for deployment and testing.

We then deploy the same open-weight model locally under several hardware configurations and fit pairs of compute time and energy GLMs from directly measured compute time and GPU power consumption. Finally, we identify the local compute time GLM that most closely matches the API behavior and use its paired energy GLM to obtain a locally grounded estimate of the API’s energy consumption.

paragraphs.en: To better isolate the time attributable to LLM computation time, we developed a benchmark specifically for time and energy estimation that incorporated a network latency estimation procedure, thereby reducing the influence of noise associated with API calls.
paragraphs.zh: 为了更好地分离可归因于大语言模型计算的时间，我们开发了一个专门用于时间和能耗估计的基准，其中包含网络延迟估计流程，从而减少了与 API 调用相关的噪声影响。

paragraphs.en: Crucially, our benchmark only aims at generating a prompt of a fixed input token length, while ensuring a fixed output length. To do so, we constructed each prompt out of three parts. Each prompt starts with a randomly generated 32bit nonce (number used once) to inhibit prefix caching, costing approximately 64 tokens. This ensures that the computations required in the prefill phase have to be executed each time and results are not retrieved from the cache. The second part consists of random sentences that can be extended until a defined input token length is reached, allowing the input token length to be scaled to arbitrarily large numbers. Finally, we added a prompt (310 tokens) that generates a large number of output tokens. To control the output token length, we used the max output token parameter Kwon et al. (2023) ; Mistral AI (2026) , which stops the decoding step once the desired output length is reached. The complete prompt is provided in the supplementary material. Using this setup, the number of input tokens of each prompt and the output tokens of the LLM’s response can be finely controlled. Since LLMs are statistical models, a desired output token length cannot be guaranteed. We safeguard against this case through reruns.
paragraphs.zh: 关键在于，我们的基准测试仅旨在生成固定输入 token 长度的提示词，同时确保固定的输出长度。 为此，我们将每个提示词由三个部分构成。 每个提示词以一个随机生成的 32 位随机数（number used once，一次性数字）开头，以抑制前缀缓存，其开销约为 64 个 token。 这确保了预填充（prefill）阶段所需的计算每次都必须执行，而结果不会从缓存中获取。 第二部分由随机句子组成，这些句子可以不断扩展，直到达到预定义的输入 token 长度，从而允许将输入 token 长度缩放到任意大的数值。 最后，我们添加了一个提示词（310 个 token），用于生成大量的输出 token。 为了控制输出 token 的长度，我们使用了最大输出 token 参数 Kwon et al. (2023)；Mistral AI (2026)，该参数一旦达到期望的输出长度就会停止解码步骤。 完整的提示词已在补充材料中提供。 使用这一设置，每个提示词的输入 token 数量以及大语言模型响应的输出 token 数量都可以被精细控制。 由于大语言模型是统计模型，因此无法保证期望的输出 token 长度。 我们通过重新运行来防范这种情况。

paragraphs.en: Existing work commonly quantifies LLM inference energy, focusing on tokens generated during the decode phase Rincé and Banse (2025) , leaving the impact of the prefill phase on time and energy consumption underexplored. However, we argue that the prefill phase is becoming increasingly important as modern LLM-based systems process progressively longer input contexts. To assess the importance of the prefill and decode phases on energy consumption, we start by investigating their impact on compute time (as energy is power over time). We set up our benchmark as a coarse grid-search, testing input token lengths between 10,000 and 200,000 with a step size of 10,000. For each input length, we test five output lengths: 100, 500, 1,000, 1,500, and 2,000 tokens. We repeat each input–output combination 10 times, resulting in 100 unique combinations (20 prompt lengths I I × \times 5 output lengths O O ). These combinations cover a broad region of the prefill space, allowing us to identify trends over a large input token range while simultaneously considering an output token range comparable to those examined in previous approaches, providing us with a more holistic understanding of compute time t c ​ o ​ m ​ p ​ u ​ t ​ e ​ ( I , O ) t_{compute}(I,O) .

paragraphs.en: The energy consumption of an API-based LLM cannot be measured directly since the underlying serving infrastructure is inaccessible. To predict it, we use compute time, which is observable through the API, to connect the API deployment with locally hosted configurations for which both compute time and energy consumption can be measured. For each local configuration, we fit a pair of GLMs: one modeling compute time and another modeling energy consumption. We then identify the local compute time GLM that most closely matches the API compute time GLM and use its paired energy GLM to estimate the energy consumption. We enabled chunked prefilling (max_num_batched_tokens=8192) in three different configurations (H100 4 GPU, TP=4; H200 2 GPU, TP=2; H200 4 GPU, TP=4) using tensor parallelism (TP). In addition to recording the compute time, we used nvidia-smi to capture the power and GPU utilization for all GPUs. paragraphs.en: This is a strong indicator that compute time prediction can serve as a reliable proxy for energy consumption. paragraphs.en: To address this, we introduced a generalized linear model (GLM) approach that accurately predicts energy and compute behavior from recorded data. Because direct energy measurements are unavailable for proprietary LLMs, we demonstrate that compute time can serve as a reliable proxy for energy consumption, enabling accurate estimation via local equivalent models.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种广义线性模型（GLM）方法，能够从记录的数据中准确预测能耗与计算行为。 由于专有大语言模型无法直接测量能耗，我们证明计算时间可以作为能耗的可靠代理指标，从而借助本地等效模型实现准确估算。
